title: A High-performance Compact Photoacoustic Tomography System for In Vivo Small-animal Brain Imaging
protocol: Mount the PLD inside the circular scanner.
Connect the PLD to the laser driver unit (LDU).
Switch on the PLD laser.
Set the PLD repetition rate to "7,000" Hz using the function generator in the LDU.
Increase the pulse energy to 1.42 mJ by setting the voltage of the variable power supply to "3.1" V.
Mount the optical diffuser (OD) in front of the PLD exit window to make the output beam homogenous.
Mount the focused UST on the UST holder, facing the center of the scanning area.
Place the ultrasound detector inside the acrylic tank.
Fill the tank with water to totally immerse the UST.
Anesthetize the animal by intraperitoneally injecting a cocktail of ketamine, xylazine, and saline.
Remove the fur on the scalp of the animal using a hair clipper.
Apply hair removal cream to the shaved area for further depletion of the fur.
Remove the applied cream after 4-5 min using a cotton swab.
Apply artificial tear ointment to the eyes of the animal.
Mount the custom-made animal holder equipped with a breathing mask on a lab-jack.
Place the animal in a prone position on the holder.
Secure the animal to the holder using surgical tape.
Ensure that the breathing mask covers the nose and mouth of the rat.
Connect the breathing mask to the anesthesia machine.
Switch on the anesthesia machine and set it to deliver 1.0 L/min of oxygen with 0.75% isoflurane.
Clamp the pulse oximeter to the tail of the rat.
Apply a layer of colorless ultrasound gel to the scalp of the rat.
Adjust the lab-jack position to the center of the scanner.
Connect the customized breathing mask to deliver inhaled anesthetic to the animal.
Set the parameters in the data acquisition software as required.
Run the data acquisition software program to start acquisition.
Observe the animal during the entire imaging period.
Reconstruct the cross-sectional brain image from the A-lines using the reconstruction software program.
Turn off the anesthesia system.
Remove the animal from the stage.
Return the animal to its cage.
Monitor the animal until it regains consciousness.
